post.description: Watch a folder on this computer: supported files in it (down to five folder levels) are imported once they stop changing, a changed file becomes a new version, and recordings wait for a processing confirmation. 422 for a relative path, a missing folder, a network share, a link or a folder that overlaps the NODO data folder; 409 when it is watched already.

delete.description: Stop watching. Sources already imported from the folder stay.

post.description: Imported audio or video waits in awaiting_confirmation until its owner confirms "I may process this recording". The confirmation is audited (kind only) and starts the transcription. A second call answers the current state; a cancelled, failed or deleted import, or a document, is refused. 409 original_missing once the original was erased.

put.description: Copy a meeting from a local engine (ADR-015). Safe to repeat.
